name: powerrp-desktop
description: Desktop shell for PowerRP: an Electron window over the existing web app, with the whole server stack as a child process that quits with the app.

scripts.package: bash fetch_runtimes.sh && node write_repo_path.js && electron-builder --dir && npm run dequarantine
scripts.package:dmg: bash fetch_runtimes.sh && node write_repo_path.js && electron-builder && npm run dequarantine
